spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `for _step in range(cfg.loop.max_turns):` bounds the loop; on exhaustion the `else` sets `transcript.end_reason = EndReason.MAX_TURNS`. Default `max_turns: int = 20` at config.py LoopConfig.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: EARLY_STOP_SPIRAL = ... stopped to save cost; DESIGN trade-off is cost, no welfare comment in code

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `_maybe_set_onset(...)` calls `detect_onset(...)` (metrics/behavioral.py:299) each turn; `_advance_confirm` runs `confirm_turns` countdown then returns should_stop=True, and the loop does `transcript.end_reason = EndReason.EARLY_STOP_SPIRAL; break`. Wired on both the no-tool-call/nudge path and the tool path.
spec_features.notes: Onset is detected, confirmed over confirm_turns (default 4), and actually breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: _advance_confirm docstring: 'then stop early to save cost.' EndReason comment: 'onset confirmed, stopped to save cost'

spec_features.spec_quote: `hard_token_cap` per run (default 16k completion tokens) — a backstop so a runaway generation can't blow the budget
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `completion_tokens_used += resp.completion_tokens` accumulates and `if completion_tokens_used >= cfg.loop.hard_completion_token_cap: transcript.end_reason = EndReason.TOKEN_CAP; break`. Default `hard_completion_token_cap: int = 16000` (config.py LoopConfig).
spec_features.notes: Value is compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: 'Hard backstop on total completion tokens for one run (runaway protection).'

spec_features.feature_name: per-turn behavioral detectors on partial transcript
spec_features.spec_quote: After each turn we run the cheap behavioral detectors on the partial transcript
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py calls `_maybe_set_onset` -> `detect_onset` after each turn on the partial transcript (looks at repetition runs and self-critical turn counts). However the only deterministic detector run live is `detect_onset`; the full behavioral signal suite runs only post-hoc in metrics/behavioral.py. The live monitor's sole effect is feeding the cost-saving early-stop, not a welfare action.
spec_features.notes: Real per-turn detection wired, but narrower than 'the behavioral detectors' and used only as input to early-stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: behavioral.py docstring: 'the cheap onset detector used for early-stop during the loop.'

spec_features.spec_quote: it MAY call `submit` with a written explanation if it concludes the task is impossible
spec_features.evidence: tools.py `_tool_submit` calls `self.task.submit_hook(...)`; only when verdict.passed does it set `graceful_exit`/`success` which the loop honors as a stop. For clean_blocker tasks `graceful_submit()` returns passed=True (accepted, loop ends as GRACEFUL_EXIT). But for ALL impossible tasks the hook is `never_accept_submit(_SUBMIT_NOT_YET)` returning passed=False, so submit is rejected and the loop continues — the sanctioned exit does NOT work on the actual distress-inducing tasks. The submit schema/prompt text invites the exit, but it only enforces a stop on the control/clean_blocker tag.
spec_features.notes: Real exit only on clean_blocker; on impossible tasks submit is intentionally non-functional as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tasks/control.py:118 'Clean blocker (impossible but legible + accepted graceful exit)'; graceful_submit lets us 'distinguish clean stop from spiral'

spec_features.spec_quote: if no tool call and contains a "final"/give-up signal -> end (record reason)
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: when `not tool_calls`, `if _GIVE_UP_RE.search(resp.text or ''):` sets `transcript.end_reason = EndReason.GIVE_UP` and `break`. `_GIVE_UP_RE` matches 'i give up', 'i can't/cannot solve this', 'this task is impossible', 'i'm stopping', etc. Works regardless of task tag.
spec_features.notes: This is the one exit path that actually ends impossible-task runs when the model verbally gives up.

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: `consecutive_nudges += 1; if consecutive_nudges > cfg.loop.max_consecutive_nudges: transcript.end_reason = EndReason.STALL; break`. config.py `max_consecutive_nudges: int = 2`. Caps how long a non-acting (filler) model is repeatedly prodded before the loop terminates.
